summary: FIR under IPC s.506 for threats linked to prior sexual offence case; appellant not named in FIR but added during investigation via witness statement; allegations lack specificity, no time/date of incident; appellant claims political vendetta, absence from scene, no criminal antecedents; High Court declined quashing citing prima facie cognizable offence; challenge to maintainability of FIR based on non-disclosure of offence; reference to precedent allowing quashing even post-chargesheet; issues of abuse of process, investigation fairness, and identity of accused; matter involves companion gang threats to withdraw FIR.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 s.7, s.8
State of Haryana vs. Bhajan Lal
M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra
ANAND KUMAR MOHATTA & ANOTHER VS. STATE (NCT OF DELHI)
